import type { CreateNoteStore } from "{{scope}}/notebook/application";
import type { Note } from "{{scope}}/notebook/domain";
import type { DrizzleDatabase } from "../drizzle-database.ts";
import { notes } from "../schema/notes.ts";

export class DrizzleCreateNoteStore implements CreateNoteStore {
  constructor(private readonly db: DrizzleDatabase) {}

  async save(note: Note): Promise<void> {
    await this.db.insert(notes).values({ id: note.id.value, text: note.text.value });
  }
}
